Class DbStringCollection

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbAbstractCollection
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbStringCollection
All Implemented Interfaces:
DbCollection
public class DbStringCollection extends DbAbstractCollection
A Collection can be represented in a database as a string containing the collection elements separated by a special character. This base class handles such a collection.
Since:
4.0.0
